basic_info.description: Grand View Ave- so aptly named! WOW is your first reaction entering the unit! This mid-century modern condo (no one living above!) is located in the heart of SF & the hills of desirable Noe Valley. Cross street is 24th- the gateway to a majority of neighborhood amenities. The Grand Views include expansive Bay, Downtown, City Lights, Bernal Park, & majestic trees/gardens nearby- endless! This move-in ready condo is part of a well managed 4-unit HOA. Other showstoppers are the open concept living space of kitchen/living/dining/home office nook leading directly to a large wrap around balcony (measured at 215 sq ft), creating perfect indoor/outdoor entertaining! And those views! The contemporary kitchen is equipped w/ high-end appliances, counter seating, & abundant cabinetry. Bed/Bath features: spacious primary bedroom w/ en suite bath, a 2nd bedroom/full guest bathroom. Both baths have skylights & exude elegance. Whether hosting guests or enjoying quiet evenings, the views & setting are unmatched. Set in a quiet yet very accessible location: minutes from top restaurants, retail, grocery, freeway & public transit. A rare opportunity for those seeking a peaceful retreat w/ quick access to everything SF has to offer. Gr8 Leased Pkg across the street-steps away! Must See in Person!!
